repo_meta_data.description: Portable memory for AI agents — enterprise-ready production thin-client. Seals agent memory client-side (ML-DSA-65 / AES-256-GCM / ML-KEM-768) and stores opaque ciphertext on the blind, non-custodial SAIHM /mcp endpoint. Pairs with @saihm/client-pro and @saihm/mcp-server.
